selection: Eight deterministic SHA-ordered records per stratum from the joined 354-record pilot. This 32-case artifact predates the final Card label supplement; use the final full pilot for release admission counts.
inputscope: After normalization and deterministic v10 repair; the builder additionally checks Stage 1/Stage 2 binding, source quality, benchmarks, deduplication and splits.
scope: Deterministic source-to-renderer lexical evidence and numeric anchor fidelity; not factual certification or model performance.
preserved_gates: Action/media/table/role flags must clear a fresh v5.4 score
v10 semantic gates applied independently by the builder
renderer_findings: Generic Table.title is not uniformly shown and does not count as visible.
Literal Text evidence silently clips at 4096 characters by default; a finite input-derived limit removes false omissions.
Table cells can be proved with exact header:value bindings per row.
Email subject/from/to values use renderer-resolved role evidence.
Generic source units retain local token order, negations, comparator signs, currency and numeric precision.
Normal static Card title/subtitle are native-visible; the supplement conservatively excludes dynamic graphs, source-link subtrees and email-shaped cards.
remaining_limits: Faithful paraphrases and reordered field labels may stay quarantined.
This does not independently prove all prose factual claims or all unsupported non-numeric additions.
Pixel rendering and tokenizer/model sequence checks are separate.
